papers.title: Selective laser melting of stainless steel and alumina composite: Experimental and simulation studies on processing parameters, microstructure and mechanical properties
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National University of Singapore, 117576, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Jun Ding
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National University of Singapore, 117576, Singapore

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了不锈钢-氧化铝复合材料的SLM制备工艺，但与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、多孔结构或骨整合无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures for stress shielding, fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制备不锈钢-氧化铝复合材料的工艺-结构-性能关系。
summary_zh.method: 实验结合仿真，优化工艺参数并表征微观结构和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 获得了致密复合材料的优化工艺窗口和力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试和仿真对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the processing-microstructure-property relationships in SLM-fabricated stainless steel-alumina composite.
summary_en.method: Combined experimental and simulation studies to optimize processing parameters and characterize microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Obtained optimal processing window and mechanical properties for dense composite.
summary_en.validation: Validation through experimental testing and simulation comparison.
